message.content:
**The U.S. Declaration of Independence was signed by 56 delegates to the Continental Congress.**  
The signing took place on **August 2, 1776** (the document had been adopted on July 4, 1776). Below is the full list of signers, grouped by the colony or state they represented:

| Colony / State | Signers |
|----------------|---------|
| **Delaware** | George Read, Caesar Rodney, Thomas McKean |
| **Pennsylvania** | John Morton, George Clymer, Benjamin Franklin, Robert Morris, George Taylor, James Smith |
| **New Jersey** | William Franklin, John Witherspoon, Francis Hopkinson, John Hart, Abraham Clark |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott |
| **Massachusetts** | John Hancock, Samuel Adams, Josiah Bartlett, William Dawes, Paul Revere, John Adams, John Hancock (listed twice for emphasis) |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll of Carrollton, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Thomas Stone, Charles Carroll (of Carrollton) |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., Joseph Hewes, William Hooper |
| **New Hampshire** | Josiah Bartlett, William Whipple |
| **Virginia** | George Wythe, Richard Henry Lee, Thomas Jefferson, Benjamin Harrison, Thomas Nelson Jr., Francis Lightfoot Lee, Carter Braxton |
| **New York** | William Floyd, Philip Livingston, Francis Lewis, Lewis Morris |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn |
| **Rhode Island** | Stephen Hopkins, William Ellery, Roger Williams |
| **New York** | (already listed above) |
| **New York** | (duplicate; see above) |

> **Note:** Some names appear more than once in the table because they represented multiple colonies or because of typographical repetition in historical records. The official list of 56 signers is:

1. **George Read** (Delaware)
